'''Deacon Eso''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during the conflict, Eso was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], as part of the Alliance's engineer contingent responsible for ensuring and assisting in the production of the Alliance's [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Eso had become a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Alliance. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], following the Alliance's victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Eso attended a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] held in the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], which honored the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH" /> Deacon Eso was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the conflict, Eso was among the engineers sent to<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Corellia Operative}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Corellia">{{DB|location|corellia|Corellia}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to ensure and assist in the production of the Alliance's [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="CCG" />

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]], which Deacon Eso was present in, to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Eso had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="Insider133">{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}}</ref> [[0 BBY/Legends|Immediately preceding]] 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] occurred, during which the Alliance destroyed the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Following the battle, the Alliance held a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]] of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], their headquarters on Yavin 4. Eso was present during the ceremony, which was held in honor of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Deacon Eso was possessed of [[Color/Legends|fair]] skin, as well as gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Skills and abilities==
While serving on Corellia, Eso was by that [[Time/Legends|time]] one of the Alliance's best engineers.<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
Captain Deacon Eso [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a dark green [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|uniform]] with a lighter green [[Hat/Legends|cap]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deacon Eso was first seen as an unnamed Rebel extra in the ending scene of the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> In [[June]] [[2012]], the character was given a name in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!'']] feature of the [[Star Wars Insider 133|133rd issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Insider133" />
